summary.text: Landon Bahl is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 17 (home city listed as Grand Forks), serving since 2023 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Bahl lists an occupation of Vice President & COO, 322 Hospitality Group, Small Business Owner.
It lists education as BA, Marketing, Entrepreneurship, Minor, Sport Business, UND.

It also lists Board of Directors: Grand Forks/East Grand Forks Chamber of Commerce, Delta Tau Delta International Fraternity, UND Student Run Enterprises, Greater Grand Forks Young Professionals Advisory Board, UND Delta Tau Delta House Corporation & Education Foundation.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Bahl's standing committee assignments as Government and Veterans Affairs and Industry, Business and Labor.
